description_en: Updates the configuration of a certificate deployment task, such as the certificates or target resources
name: UpdateDeploymentJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task from the JobId parameter. You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712223.html operation to obtain the ID of a deployment task
parameters.help_zh: 部署任务ID。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712234.html返回的任务ID。也可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712223.html接口获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the deployment task
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the certificate. Separate multiple certificate IDs with commas (,). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html operation to obtain the ID of a certificate from the CertificateId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 证书ID，多个证书ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html返回的**CertificateId**
parameters.name: cert_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud resource. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712230.html operation to obtain the ID of a cloud resource from the Id parameter
parameters.help_zh: 云产品资源ID。多个资源ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712230.html返回的主键**Id**
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the contact. Separate multiple contact IDs with commas (,). You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712221.html operation to obtain the ID of a contact from the ContactId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 联系人ID。多个联系人ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。此处ID为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712221.html返回的主键**Id**
parameters.name: contact_ids

parameters.help_en: The time when the task starts. The value is a UNIX timestamp. If you do not specify this parameter, the system immediately starts the task after it is created
parameters.help_zh: 设置任务开始调度的时间（Unix时间戳）。如果不设置，默认创建任务后立即执行部署
parameters.name: schedule_time

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
